runtime_fields.description: Optional runtime replacement for the output location.

payload.sql: SELECT "t0"."target_id" AS "target_id", "t0"."target_symbol" AS "target_symbol", expanded0."item"."disease_id" AS "disease_id", expanded1."item" AS "evidence_label", "t0"."study_id" AS "study_id", "t0"."score" AS "score" FROM "kg_table_0" AS t0 CROSS JOIN UNNEST("t0"."evidence") AS expanded0(item) CROSS JOIN UNNEST(expanded0."item"."labels") AS expanded1(item)

SELECT *, 'binding:1b21711b75c73021' AS _kg_binding_symbol FROM (SELECT CONCAT('target::', "plan"."target_id") AS "build_key", "plan"."symbol" AS "symbol" FROM (SELECT * FROM "kg_table_3" AS t0) AS plan)

SELECT *, 'binding:ac2acae68f1d89af' AS _kg_binding_symbol FROM (SELECT CONCAT('study::', "plan"."id") AS "build_key", COALESCE("plan"."details"."name", 'Unknown study') AS "name" FROM (SELECT * FROM "kg_table_2" AS t0) AS plan)

SELECT *, 'binding:53dd03da47cf145e' AS _kg_binding_symbol FROM (SELECT CONCAT('disease::', "plan"."disease_id") AS "build_key", "plan"."name" AS "name" FROM (SELECT * FROM "kg_table_1" AS t0) AS plan)

SELECT *, 'binding:1655a3310550c5ec' AS _kg_binding_symbol FROM (SELECT MD5(CONCAT("plan"."target_id", "plan"."disease_id", "plan"."evidence_label")) AS "build_key", CONCAT('target::', "plan"."target_id") AS "source_build_key", CONCAT('disease::', "plan"."disease_id") AS "target_build_key", "plan"."score" AS "score", COALESCE("plan"."details"."name", 'Unknown study') AS "study_name", "plan"."disease_id" AS "evidence_disease_id", "plan"."evidence_label" AS "evidence_label" FROM (SELECT * FROM "kg_projection_0" AS t0 LEFT JOIN "kg_table_2" AS t1 ON "t1"."id" = "t0"."study_id") AS plan)

payload.select: "build_key", min("source_build_key") AS "source_build_key", min("target_build_key") AS "target_build_key", min("score") AS "score", min("study_name") AS "study_name", min("evidence_disease_id") AS "evidence_disease_id", min("evidence_label") AS "evidence_label"
